# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 17 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-16 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_bard_level16_widening.rs) to level 17 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/performance posture from the level-1 through level-16
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The PF1
# Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-17 "Special" column reads "Inspire
# courage +4, lore master 3/day" — verified independently against two
# primary sources (d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror,
# both byte-for-byte identical: "+12/+7/+2 | +5 | +10 | +10 | Inspire
# courage +4, lore master 3/day"), with neighboring levels 16 ("—", blank)
# and 18 ("Mass suggestion, versatile performance") fetched too to rule out
# misattribution. Base attack bonus and both good saves (Reflex, Will) and
# poor Fortitude, Bardic Knowledge, the Fascinate DC, and the Fascinate
# affected-creature count all stay numerically unchanged from level 16
# (17*3/4=12, 17/3=5, 17/2+2=10, max(17/2,1)=8, 10+17/2+CHA=20,
# 1+(17-1)/3=6 — every one an integer-division coincidence with level 16's
# own values), while the Bardic Performance rounds-per-day pool genuinely
# rises (4+CHA+2*(17-1)=38, up from 36) and Inspire Courage and Lore Master
# both genuinely reach their fourth/third tier respectively (Inspire
# Courage +3->+4, Lore Master take-20 2/day->3/day), the same
# every-six-bard-levels-after-5th cadence as their own level-11 tier rise.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion execution, no Dirge of Doom execution,
# no Inspire Greatness execution, no untrained-skill-use execution for
# Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master take-10/take-20 execution against any
# actual Knowledge check, no Soothing Performance healing/condition-removal
# execution, no Frightening Tune fear-resolution execution, no Inspire
# Heroics targeting/save/AC-application execution, and no spontaneous
# known-spell / slot posture burden.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level17
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:17
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
